fact.description: The qualified name of the fact for which this KPIMatrix record is intended. Example: energy.fRsrcCon

dim.description: The id (Note that the name of the dimension is defined in @analyticExtract.kpiMatrixDim) of the dimension. Example:"naturalgas" or "electricity" or "energy" ...

measure.description: The name of the timeseries measure that the KPI corresponds to. Example: "budget_spend_qty" or "actual_consumption_invoiced_qty" or ...

kpiId.description: The id of the KPI for this dimension and measure combination.
